privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: ONWISH only collects what we need to give you recommendations. We don't ask for your real name, phone number or address.

ul: Email address and name — to create your account and log you in. Your password is stored only as a one-way hash; we can't read it.

Streamer profile — what you choose or type in the recommendation form: strengths, a one-line style note, face-cam use, audience size, devices, stream length and time, goal, community, genres to skip, and whether to avoid horror, motion sickness or spoilers.
Collab member info — only nicknames, roles on stream, devices and owned games. There is no field for members' real names or contact details.
Saved picks — recommendation cards you pressed “Save” on, with the profile at that time.
Usage records — when you requested recommendations, request IDs, your monthly count, and the results. Used to manage monthly limits and repeated requests.
Login-attempt records — to block brute-force attacks we briefly count login and password-reset attempts. Emails and IP addresses are stored only as hashes.
Error reports — what you reported, what it was about, and when.
Cookies — only to keep you logged in and remember your language. The login cookie can't be read by JavaScript, and we use no advertising or tracking cookies.
Logging you in and verifying it's you
Recommending content that fits your answers, and showing your profile and saved picks
Managing monthly AI limits and overall service cost
Receiving and fixing error reports

p: While AI recommendations are turned on, the profile items above (including collab members' nicknames, roles, devices and owned games) are sent to the AI service (Anthropic). Account details such as your email and login information are never sent. When AI is off, nothing is sent and we recommend using simple rules on our server.
These providers' servers may be located outside your country. We never sell your information or use it for advertising.
ul: Data storage and login: Supabase
AI recommendations: Anthropic (only when AI is on)
Verification emails: an email delivery service (when configured)
A hosting service to run the site

sections.h: How long we keep it and how to delete it
ul: Reset profile — delete it any time from the profile page.
Delete saved picks — one by one or all at once.
Delete account — from the profile page; your account, profile, saved picks and usage records are deleted together.
Even after you delete your account, the text of error reports stays to help improve the service, but it is no longer linked to you.
Login-attempt records are deleted automatically within a day.

p: You can see your profile and saved picks on the [[/profile|profile page]]. Only you can see this information — other users and visitors can't.
For privacy questions or requests, log in and use the “Report an error” button on any page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lead: ONWISH helps internet streamers choose what to stream today and keep an eye on the games that are hot. Please read the following before you use it.

ul: The content library and Game Radar can be used without logging in.
Recommendations, saving your profile and saving picks need a login.
Recommendations are for reference only. We don't promise any result or viewer reaction.
You sign up and log in with an email and password. Keep your password and verification links to yourself.
One account is for one person. You can delete your account any time on the [[/profile|profile page]].

p: While AI recommendations are available, each account gets {limit} free ones per month (Korea time, refilled at 00:00 on the 1st). A recommendation only counts when all 3 picks fit. If you run out or AI isn't available, we show rule-based “basic picks” instead. Limits and methods may change depending on the service, and we'll announce changes here.

ul: Game info is shown with its source and the date it was last checked. Values we couldn't confirm are marked “To be confirmed”.
Information can change or be wrong. Tell us about mistakes with “Report an error” on each page.
Game names and images belong to their respective owners.

p: If we find this happening, we may restrict your use.
ul: Using automated means to request recommendations repeatedly or put excessive load on the service
Using someone else's account or trying to bypass the service's security
Using error reports for false claims or advertising
Typing information we don't ask for, such as members' real names or contact details, into other fields

p: We may change some features or pause the service for maintenance, cost or third-party reasons. When we can, we'll tell you here in advance.

Recommendations and game info are provided as they are. Except where the service caused it intentionally or through gross negligence, we aren't responsible for outcomes from streaming or buying games based on them.
What we collect and how we use it is described in the [[/privacy|Privacy Policy]].
For questions, log in and use “Report an error” on any page.
